scope: Nine existing enabled debt routes; decision preparation only

decisions.reason: Official documentation page slug ends in /ticker but declared wire path does not; observed one legacy 404.
decisions.request_difference: Official GET takes ticker or cik query. Preserve existing ANY admission/opaque request unless separately approved; candidate repairs GET forwarding only.
decisions.response_difference: Official CompanyFactsResponse has company_facts. No schema authority for current incorrect target.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Exact new immutable Profile plus binding/target SQL package and independent review still required; this is not approved SQL.

decisions.reason: No rows in bounded window; current official MCP source still references crypto history, but current OpenAPI has no crypto operations. Absence does not establish retirement.
decisions.request_difference: MCP uses /crypto/prices/ with ticker, interval, interval_multiplier,start_date,end_date; current target lacks trailing slash. No declared slash alias equivalence.
decisions.response_difference: MCP JSON serialization is not a typed provider response contract; stock /prices is a different instrument universe.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Obtain owning crypto operation/response contract or explicit product retirement decision; do not repoint to stock prices.

decisions.reason: One real success in 30 days, so retiring solely because documentation omits it would discard a working route.
decisions.request_difference: MCP references /crypto/prices/snapshot/?ticker=...; current target lacks trailing slash.
decisions.response_difference: No authoritative full response declaration in current OpenAPI. Stock snapshot is not a crypto replacement.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Obtain crypto-specific response authority; preserve active route pending it.

decisions.reason: No bounded-window usage, but no explicit retirement statement. New /earnings is a filing-centric API, not a proven press-release alias.
decisions.request_difference: New ticker required, limit 1..40 counts report periods; cursor pagination. Existing opaque ANY admits unconstrained input.
decisions.response_difference: New earnings array contains SEC filings, source_type, filing URLs and financial data; not promised press-release text contract.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Choose new filing API as a separate/versioned product or approve compatibility translation; no target-only rewrite.

decisions.reason: Current official segmented income statement operation can serve revenue breakdown intent but has a broader contract.
decisions.request_difference: New annual/quarterly period is required; ticker or cik; limit/filter/cursor semantics.
decisions.response_difference: segmented_financials array contains revenue plus operating_income/depreciation and next_page_url; no evidence this equals old segmented-revenues envelope.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Confirm caller compatibility or introduce a versioned replacement; do not silently swap response envelope.

decisions.reason: 13 failed HTTP410 rows in 30 days and no successes. Official current holdings operation matches business intent but is not a declared alias.
decisions.request_difference: ticker OR filer_cik, mutual exclusion; limit/cursor and report_period filters must be reviewed.
decisions.response_difference: institutional_holdings array plus mode-specific ticker/filer_cik and next_page_url; current contract is position-centric 13F.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Approve changed request/response product contract before compiling a new Profile and exact SQL; do not claim backward-compatible target-only repair.

decisions.reason: 43 successes and 8 failed400 in seven days; 190 successes and 18 failed400 in 30 days. Strong evidence against retirement.
decisions.request_difference: Existing GET declares optional string limit/period/ticker. Keep current validation and pricing.
decisions.response_difference: Current official OpenAPI does not declare /analyst-estimates; orphan/history models alone do not establish operation-specific authority.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Obtain owner-published exact legacy response declaration. Successful status does not prove schema.

decisions.reason: No current official GET single-search-result operation; search results are returned by POST /stays/search and enhanced by fetch_all_rates. No bounded-window logs.
decisions.request_difference: Official alternative changes GET to POST action with required search_result_id and no body. Reusing old GET would change method/safety behavior.
decisions.response_difference: Official alternative returns full SearchResult under data, including rooms/rates; no current GET wire contract.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Prefer a separately declared POST rates action and planned deprecation of undocumented GET, only after explicit decision; no automatic disabling.

decisions.reason: Official fetch-all-rates action directly matches rates intent, but current GET /rates has no official declaration. No bounded-window logs.
decisions.request_difference: GET /rates -> POST /actions/fetch_all_rates, path parameter id maps to search_result_id; no request body. Do not silently change public method or proxy unsafe POST behind existing GET.
decisions.response_difference: Full SearchResult envelope data with all room/rate details, not a guaranteed rates-only list; expired search results can fail.
decisions.blocking_decision_or_authority: Approve separate POST product/route and old GET deprecation policy or explicitly reviewed compatibility behavior. Preserve Duffel-Version:v2 and existing pricing unless separately approved.
